idea-plugin.name: Vim Strict IME Guard
idea-plugin.description:
Keeps Chinese and other non-ASCII input out of IdeaVim command modes on Linux with Fcitx5.

The plugin guards COMMAND, VISUAL, SELECT and OP_PENDING modes. It does not handle Insert/Replace mode, so it can work together with IdeaVimExtension for input-method restoration.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
